item.title: Harbor Bridge reopens after 18-month repair
item.description: The Harbor Bridge in Port Elm reopened to traffic on Monday after an 18-month repair project.

item.title: Battery recycling plant opens in Ridgefield
item.description: A battery recycling plant opened in Ridgefield on Tuesday.

item.title: Pelicans win regional championship final
item.description: The Port Elm Pelicans won the regional basketball championship final on Monday night, the biggest night on the city's sports calendar.
